name: PT DFI Retail Nusantara Tbk
summary: PT DFI Retail Nusantara Tbk engages in the special retail business in Indonesia. It operates pharmacies; drugs stores; health and beauty stores, that offers skin, personal, and baby care products; as well as home furnishing stores under the Guardian and IKEA brands. The company was formerly known as PT Hero Supermarket Tbk and changed its name to PT DFI Retail Nusantara Tbk in December 2024. The company was founded in 1971 and is based in Tangerang Selatan, Indonesia. PT DFI Retail Nusantara Tbk is a subsidiary of Mulgrave Corporation B.V.
